title: Prehistoric Picture Walk
hook: A good picture shows evidence without pretending we know every color.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one clear beat before the answer
visualStyle: colorful 3D prehistoric-life storybook, fern greens and warm earth tones, calm creatures, uncluttered scene pieces

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child comparing museum art with fossil evidence
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: picture cue -> recall beat -> target -> frame/point gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a short museum-xylophone note and muted marimba step after the target.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a short museum-xylophone note and muted marimba step after the target
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Turn Prehistoric Picture Walk into a museum reconstruction gallery: each image separates fossil-supported anatomy from artist reconstruction, especially color, soft tissue, behavior and habitat composition.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child walks frame by frame and asks which parts are fossil, which are inference, and which are artistic choices.
